Missing rate is concentrated in SITE_B. 100% of missing/sentinel vitamin_d values originate from SITE_B patients (P011, P014, P016, P017, P019). SITE_A missing rate = 0%.
Missing rate increases monotonically over time. T0: 2/20 = 10% (2 sentinels); T1: 5/21 = 24%; T2: 8/21 = 38%. Suggests deteriorating data collection at later time windows.

Entity P015 is present in 03_visits as a foreign-key reference but has zero rows there. P015 appears in lab_results (3 rows), dexa_scans (2 rows), and device_records (4 rows) but is entirely absent from visits.
Clinical impossibility: diastolic blood pressure exceeds systolic in row VIS-039 (P013-T2). systolic_bp = 85 mmHg, diastolic_bp = 92 mmHg. Diastolic > systolic is physiologically impossible.

Implausible per-entity trajectory. Patient P001: body_fat_pct drops from 24.5% (T0) to 7.2% (T2) — a 17.3-percentage-point decrease in 6 months. This exceeds 3× the IQR of all per-entity deltas and is physiologically implausible.

Implausible per-entity trajectory. Patient P009: creatinine_mg_dl spikes from 1.38 (T0) to 8.92 (T1) then returns to 1.30 (T2). The T0→T1 jump of +7.54 mg/dL is physiologically implausible as a within-90-day change without a corresponding clinical event.
Value outside declared valid set. Row QST-011 (P006-T0): activity_level = 'EXTREME'. Valid values are {SEDENTARY, LIGHT, MODERATE, VIGOROUS, VERY_ACTIVE}.
Value outside declared valid set. Row QST-025 (P013-T0): diet_type = 'ATKINS'. Valid values are {OMNIVORE, PESCATARIAN, VEGETARIAN, VEGAN, KETO, MEDITERRANEAN, PALEO}.
Value outside declared valid set. Row QST-034 (P017-T1): energy_level = 'VERY_HIGH'. Valid values are {LOW, MODERATE, HIGH}.
Duplicate rows on minimal grain key. Key (P005, 2024-04-19, T1) appears twice: rows LAB-014 and LAB-061 are identical on all clinical columns.
Per-entity rows not in temporal order. Patient P012: visit_date sequence is 2024-08-14 (T0) → 2024-05-16 (T1) → 2024-02-16 (T2) — reversed chronological order. T0 date is later than T2 date.
Discharge before admission. Row VIS-023 (P008-T1): admission_datetime = '2024-05-05 10:30', discharge_datetime = '2024-05-05 08:00'. Duration = −2h 30m.
Event timestamped after recorded death. Row VIS-009 (P003-T2): visit_date = 2024-07-25, but patients.death_date for P003 = 2024-07-20. Event occurs 5 days post-mortem.

Near-duplicate entity pair detected. P017 (M, 1980-06-25, SITE_B, 81.0 kg, 174 cm) and P018 (M, 1980-06-28, SITE_B, 60.2 kg, 166 cm) share the same sex, site, and birth year-month with only a 3-day date gap. Possible duplicate registration.
Orphan foreign key detected. Row LAB-062 in lab_results references patient_id = 'P025', which does not exist in 01_patients. 1 orphan row.
Event date precedes enrollment date. Row DEX-019 in dexa_scans: scan_date = 2024-01-20 for patient P010, whose enrollment_date in 01_patients = 2024-02-10. Scan performed 21 days before enrollment.

Same concept disagrees across tables for the same entity. Patient P004: weight_kg in 01_patients = 58.7 kg (baseline), but weight_kg in 03_visits (VIS-012, T2) = 47.2 kg — an 11.5 kg discrepancy (19.6%) that exceeds a plausible 6-month weight change.
